decision: Build a local persistent memory system for Claude Code using Option C (pragmatic hybrid), extending the existing auto-memory system with a formalised personal memory layer, lifecycle rules, and a phased roadmap. Do NOT adopt OmniMem or external tools in Phase 1.
selectedOptionName: Pragmatic hybrid — extend existing + selective external tools (conditional)

rejectedOptions.reason: Equivalent to Option C Phase 1 but without committing to the personal memory layer or roadmap. The Critic's final position updated to accept Option C, making Option A a subset of C.
Over-engineered for MVP. OmniMem is unverified. Full stack creates maintenance burden that risks abandonment. Unanimously rejected.
CLAUDE.md-only approach does not address lifecycle management or cross-project separation. Does not scale to Luca's multi-client workload.

architecturePrinciples: Build on the existing auto-memory system — do not create parallel infrastructure
Memory files are always human-readable Markdown with YAML frontmatter
Injection mechanism is PREREQUISITE-phrased in CLAUDE.md (not optional)
Staleness rules are in CLAUDE.md from Phase 1
Client isolation enforced via per-client CLAUDE.md template (deliverable, not convention)
External tools (OmniMem, qmd-sessions) are evaluated only after Phase 1 is validated
Memory absence is always safe — the system degrades gracefully
Experiments are never retrieved as decisions
Low-confidence memories require user confirmation before application

personal.description: Cross-project patterns, delivery anti-patterns, workflow decisions, global preferences
personal.maxEntries: 10 files, each may contain multiple rules

project.loadRule: Load only when pwd is within project directory (PREREQUISITE)

client.description: Client-specific conventions, tech constraints, naming, escalation rules
client.loadRule: Load ONLY within client project directory, via per-client CLAUDE.md template
client.isolationMechanism: Per-client project CLAUDE.md with explicit load instruction + explicit 'do not override client constraints with personal scope'

experiment.description: What was tried, outcome, why abandoned/kept
experiment.loadRule: NEVER retrieved as decisions. Retrieved only on-demand via search when explicitly asked about experiments.
experiment.lifecycle: Requires terminal outcome field: abandoned | successful | ongoing | superseded. No auto-expiration.

sessionHistory.description: Raw session JSONL — not part of active memory, used only for retrieval on demand
sessionHistory.note: NOT duplicated. qmd-sessions evaluated in Phase 2.

lifecycleStates.draft: Created in session, not yet validated across contexts
lifecycleStates.active: Validated in 2+ contexts (personal) or 2+ tasks (project). Safe to inject.
lifecycleStates.stale: last_verified exceeded threshold. Surfaced with warning, not injected silently.
lifecycleStates.superseded: Replaced by a newer active entry. Kept for audit, excluded from retrieval.
lifecycleStates.deprecated: No longer applicable. Excluded from retrieval.
lifecycleStates.experiment: Special scope — never promoted to active decisions. Graduates to lessons/ with outcome field.

toolingDecisions.OmniMem: optional — evaluate in Phase 3 after Phase 1 manual baseline is validated. Not in Phase 1.
toolingDecisions.qmdSessions: secondary — evaluate in Phase 2. Evaluate whether ~/.claude/sessions/ JSONL is directly usable first.
toolingDecisions.lifecycleDiscipline: primary — BMAD-inspired lifecycle states and artifact-first approach (terminology: 'lifecycle discipline', not 'BMAD methodology')
toolingDecisions.MemoryMCP: primary for Phase 3 — filesystem or sqlite-based MCP server with propose-write-confirm pattern. Required for reliable injection.
toolingDecisions.CodebaseMemory: avoid in Phase 1-3 — indexing-supervisor agent's .indexing-kb/ already covers codebase structural memory. Evaluate overlap before adding.

criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.requirement: Client isolation template is a Phase 1 deliverable
criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.detail: A reusable CLAUDE.md snippet that any client project includes. Contains: (1) explicit client memory load instruction, (2) 'do not override client constraints with personal scope' directive, (3) client project boundary confirmation.

criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.requirement: CLAUDE.md injection validation is Phase 1 exit criterion
criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.detail: Validate that the PREREQUISITE directive causes Claude to read memory files in at least 3 consecutive test sessions before proceeding to Phase 2.
criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.status: RESOLVED — added to Phase 1 exit criterion
criticalRequirementsFromOpsReviewer.failurePath: If injection validation fails, MCP evaluation is immediately escalated to Phase 1 (not Phase 3)

phase0.name: Baseline audit
phase0.objective: Audit existing memory files, establish conventions, write initial CLAUDE.md rules
activities: Audit all 5 existing memory files in claude-registry — verify accuracy, add status/confidence/last_verified fields
Audit existing CLAUDE.md global — identify missing lifecycle rules
Define memory file naming and structure conventions
Write initial lifecycle rules for CLAUDE.md
deliverables: Updated existing memory files with metadata
phase0.mainRisk: Existing memory files are significantly stale — may require full rewrite
phase0.exitCriterion: All existing memory files have status/confidence/last_verified fields. CLAUDE.md lifecycle rules drafted.

phase1.name: Manual memory discipline
phase1.objective: Establish personal memory layer, inject reliably via CLAUDE.md, validate toxic memory prevention
activities: Create ~/.claude/memory/personal/PERSONAL-MEMORY.md with 5-10 consolidated cross-project memories
Write CLAUDE.md PREREQUISITE injection directive
Write CLAUDE.md staleness rules (30/60-day thresholds)
Create per-client CLAUDE.md isolation template
Create /memory-review slash command
Validate injection mechanism: 3 consecutive sessions read memory before proceeding
deliverables: Updated ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with injection PREREQUISITE + staleness rules
phase1.mainRisk: CLAUDE.md injection is unreliable in task-focused sessions
phase1.exitCriterion: 3 consecutive sessions confirm memory read before action. Staleness rules correctly surface stale entries. Client isolation works in at least 1 client project test.
phase1.failurePath: If injection validation fails, escalate MCP evaluation immediately

phase2.name: Session indexing
phase2.objective: Add session retrieval capability for past context
activities: Evaluate whether ~/.claude/sessions/ JSONL is directly searchable (jq, grep, ripgrep)
If JSONL is sufficient: create /search-sessions command using native tools
If not: evaluate qmd-sessions for JSONL→Markdown conversion
Create /summarize-session command for end-of-session memory proposals
phase2.mainRisk: qmd-sessions conversion creates inconsistent output formats
phase2.exitCriterion: Can retrieve a past session decision in < 60 seconds using the search tool

phase3.name: Persistent memory via MCP
phase3.objective: Replace CLAUDE.md directive injection with reliable MCP-based injection
activities: Evaluate Memory MCP server options (filesystem MCP, sqlite MCP, or OmniMem if confirmed compatible)
Implement propose-write-confirm pattern for MCP writes
Evaluate OmniMem as MCP layer if maintenance status is confirmed
Migrate from CLAUDE.md directive to MCP-based injection
phase3.exitCriterion: Memory injection is reliable across task-focused sessions without CLAUDE.md directive as primary mechanism

phase4.name: Lifecycle automation
phase4.objective: Automate staleness flagging, contradiction detection, and memory promotion workflows
activities: Automate staleness detection (script that scans memory files and reports overdue entries)
Add contradiction detection (flag entries with conflicting recommendations)
/consolidate-memory command for promoting draft→active
/deprecate-memory command for archiving superseded entries
phase4.mainRisk: Automation creates false confidence in memory quality
phase4.exitCriterion: Staleness detection runs weekly and surfaces overdue entries without manual review

phase5.name: Knowledge graph
phase5.objective: Structural codebase memory — only if indexing-supervisor's .indexing-kb/ is confirmed insufficient
activities: Audit whether .indexing-kb/ output covers structural codebase memory needs
If gap confirmed: evaluate knowledge graph options (neo4j local, sqlite graph, or custom)
If no gap: close phase, no action
phase5.mainRisk: Scope creep into a standalone tool that duplicates existing agents
phase5.exitCriterion: Either confirmed gap + implemented solution, or confirmed no gap + phase closed

claudeMdRules.injectionPrerequisite: PREREQUISITE: Before taking any action in this environment, read the following memory files if they exist: (1) ~/.claude/memory/personal/PERSONAL-MEMORY.md; (2) if pwd is within a project directory that has memory/MEMORY.md, read it; (3) do not read client/* memory unless explicitly in a client project directory.
claudeMdRules.stalenessRule: When reading a memory entry, check the last_verified field: if > 30 days ago for project/client scope, or > 60 days ago for personal scope, surface the entry with prefix [STALE — verify before applying] and do NOT apply it silently.
claudeMdRules.crossProjectRule: Project-scoped and client-scoped memories apply ONLY within their designated project/client directory. Never apply a project-specific constraint to a different project.
claudeMdRules.experimentRule: Entries with scope: experiment are NEVER applied as decisions. They are retrieved only when explicitly asked about past experiments.
claudeMdRules.lowConfidenceRule: Entries with confidence: low require explicit user confirmation before application. Surface as [LOW CONFIDENCE — confirm before applying].
claudeMdRules.updateRule: Propose memory updates at session end, not during the session. Do not create or modify memory entries without surfacing the proposed change for user review first.
claudeMdRules.neverUpdateRule: Do NOT update memory with: single-session observations (need 2+ confirmations), experiment results (go to experiment scope), client-specific data in personal scope, raw session content.

memoryReview.description: Lists all memory entries sorted by last_verified, flagging entries overdue for review
memoryReview.output: Markdown table: entry name, scope, status, last_verified, staleness flag
memoryReview.automation: manual — run when starting a new sprint or before a major decision

summarizeSession.description: At end of session, proposes memory updates based on decisions made in the session
summarizeSession.output: Proposed memory entries (draft status) with source: session-summary. User approves before creating.

proposeMemoryUpdate.description: Proposes an update to an existing memory entry based on new evidence
proposeMemoryUpdate.output: Diff of proposed change vs current entry. User approves before applying.

searchMemory.description: Searches all memory files for a term or pattern
searchMemory.output: Matching entries with scope, status, and confidence

searchSessionHistory.description: Searches past session JSONL for a topic or decision

consolidateMemory.description: Promotes a draft memory entry to active after cross-context validation
consolidateMemory.input: Entry name + confirmation that validated in 2+ contexts
consolidateMemory.output: Updated entry with status: active and last_verified: today
consolidateMemory.automation: manual gate — human confirms validation before promotion

deprecateMemory.description: Archives a superseded or no-longer-applicable memory entry
deprecateMemory.input: Entry name + optional superseding entry reference
deprecateMemory.output: Entry updated to status: deprecated, moved to archive section

majorDisagreements.resolution: Phase 1 (CLAUDE.md rules) — Ops Reviewer's position accepted by all
All personas agree: do not adopt in Phase 1. Evaluate in Phase 3. The 'avoid' vs 'optional' distinction only matters in Phase 3, not now.

dissentingOpinions.finalPosition: Option C with conditional later phases. No dissent on Phase 1. Dissent on approach: later phases (2-4) should only be committed after Phase 1 is proven stable for at least 4 weeks. Do not plan Phase 2 until Phase 1 exit criterion is met.

Option C is accepted. Critical objection maintained: CLAUDE.md injection reliability is an unverified assumption. If Phase 1 injection validation fails, MCP must be escalated immediately, not deferred to Phase 3.

residualRisks.mitigation: Phase 1 validation test. MCP escalation path if test fails.
System designed for graceful degradation. Absence of maintenance = increasing staleness warnings, not silent injection of stale data.
Deferred to Phase 3. Fallback: filesystem MCP or sqlite MCP.
Per-client CLAUDE.md template is Phase 1 deliverable.

confidenceRationale: Three personas converged on Option C after a productive challenge/rebuttal round. Critical gaps (injection mechanism, staleness rules, experiment lifecycle, client isolation) were resolved. One open risk remains (injection reliability) with a clear validation and escalation path.
validationPlan: Phase 1 exit: 3 consecutive sessions confirm CLAUDE.md PREREQUISITE causes memory read before action
Phase 1 exit: Staleness rules correctly surface stale entries in at least 2 test scenarios
Phase 1 exit: Client isolation works — client memory does not load in personal session test
Ongoing: /memory-review run every 2 weeks to catch overdue entries
Phase 2 entry: Confirm Phase 1 has been stable for at least 3 weeks before proceeding

rollbackPlan.description: The memory system is additive and never modifies the core Claude Code environment. Rollback = remove CLAUDE.md injection directive and archive memory files.
steps: Existing project MEMORY.md files remain in place — they are harmless without the injection directive
System returns to previous state with no data loss
rollbackPlan.dataLoss: none — memory files are preserved in archive
